text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's late into the night when I finish work.
Figuring
I'd better get going, I'm
speedwalking through
campus when I
run into Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah. We meet again.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Elysium is possessed of
darkness, but so
too is Tartarus. I musn't
allow its corruption to
take hold of me.
choice_data_list_en: Are you on your way home too?
Are you on your way home too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She monologues as we walk, and I barely
get half
of what she's saying. Soon, we
come across
someone else.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Dang it... They won't open!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is all your fault! If you hadn't
dragged
your feet so much, we wouldn't
be stuck here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?! I'm not the one who took
her sweet
time putting her stuff away!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I recognize those voices.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Vodka. O unwavering aesthete. What

predicament have you found yourself in?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, is that you, Gim?! The gym
doors
won't open!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It must be because it's so late. Maybe we
should
call for help?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The door is durable, that is certain.
Which would
make it all the more
impressive... to destroy.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect opportunity to
showcase my
strength.... Hahaha! I have
no reason to hesitate.
For I am—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Always choosing the path of
violence. Fear
is a foreign concept to
you, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What of it? Are you here to spoil my
fun?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, quite the opposite. In fact, I've just

developed a chemical capable of
hardening resin
in record time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was pondering how to test it, but lo
and behold!
You entered the
picture—bold, audacious, and
believing
yourself free to commit your crimes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Free to commit my crimes, hmm?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You speak as if I were a certain
self-deluded
criminal from northern
climes. Sorry to disappoint
you, but I am
not so rash.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so? And here I'd only
thought to
provide you with the weapon
to aid you in your
quest for destruction.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, this is a pity. I had believed you would have no qualms with utilizing more... extreme methods.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Wait! A moment, please, Porfiry!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You would aid me, then? A sagacious
scholar
such as yourself?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am curious to see what would
happen if we
were to combine my
acumen with your thew.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The one who seeks, and the one who
acts. To
think such polar opposites
would work in tandem
to commit a
crime. Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! So we are to stray from the
script,
altering it to our whims?! How
taboo! But this
must be fate!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful, wonderful! Come, then! Let
us stain
ourselves in sin together,
knowing that we will
reap the spoiled
bounty we have sown!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your resolve is impressive. Very well!
Onward, for
progress!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get most of that, but from the
sounds of
it, they've got a plan!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sure they'll get us out of here in
no time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet sound
optimistic, but
I'm afraid I can't say the
same. I'm almost certain
we're in for a
huge catastrophe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good! The resin has already hardened!
Your fists
are now encased in what may
as well be steel
armor!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah hah hah! It is as though I have the
skin of the
invulnerable dragonslayer
himself!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I feel unshackled, unburdened! My
pathos was for
this moment, and this
moment alone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRASH!

text_block_list.name: Tachyon and Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Ahahaha! AAAHAHAHA!
...What is all this noise about?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Th-the door! It's completely crumpled!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I rushed here after hearing the gym
doors had
accidentally been locked...
and who do I find but
you lot?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoops. It seems the real magistrate has
entered
the scene.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It appears we have been caught
red—nay,
scarlet-handed in our crime.
No matter. At least
my wish to see how
the story unfolds has been
granted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Tanino Gimlet and Agnes
Tachyon
are tasked with repairing the
door as
punishment... but they're both as
cheery as ever,
and utterly unrepentant.
That's enough, Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I rushed here after hearing the gym
doors had
accidentally been locked...
and who do I find but
you lot?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second—were you two trying to
break
down the door?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Damn, what ill luck. To think you would
catch us
at the eleventh hour...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Alas! It seems we were doomed to obey
the script
from the beginning!
